text:
Our field sales team piloted an AI note-taker for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

1. Admin time dropped. Reps reclaimed about five hours a week, mostly from CRM updates they used to do in parking lots.

2. Better notes beat more notes. Summaries helped, but only after we agreed on a template: pain, budget, timeline, next step.

3. Trust came first. Customers asked about recording. Reps who explained it upfront saw almost no pushback.

4. Managers changed too. Coaching shifted from "how'd it go?" to reviewing real moments.

5. Not everything transcribes well. Noisy job sites and heavy jargon needed manual cleanup.

The tool didn't make reps better sellers. It gave them time and memory back.

What are you seeing in your own team?
